card.title: DELAYING TACTICS
card.text: All units in the frontline must Retreat.
card.flavorText: A delaying tactic is intended to slow an enemy force down, generally called “Defense in depth” or “Elastic Defense” in military terms. This tactic is often used when facing an enemy with superior numbers, and the goal is to minimize your own losses while reducing, eliminating or slowing down the enemy. This tactic was used in various forms by most fighting nations during WWII, but most notably by Germany and Japan.
